# Reference coverage {#reference-coverage}

Part III will hold one man-style reference page per tool in the
catalogue, grouped under its category — generated from the tool
manifest and each tool's packaged interface, with a version-lock note
naming the exact tool version a page was written against.

**Status: in build.** The generation pipeline and the coverage check
that proves every tool has a page (or an explicit pending stub) are
the next lanes in the 2026.01 window. Until they land, this part is
deliberately empty rather than partially hand-written — the coverage
guarantee means a tool either has a derived page, or an explained
stub, or the section is not published at all.
